answer: Weakest link is peer vouching: sockpuppets can vouch for each other. Close it by weighting each vouch by escrowed stake and historical accuracy, then slashing voucher and vouched on proven fraud, with unique hardware-bound keys. Colluders must burn real capital across many identities, so forging a marble-solid track record costs more than the sybil payoff, even if a saffron trader bribes a canyon full of peers.
